definition_zh: 宪法的；章程的；体质的；保健散步
definition_en: relating to a constitution (the body of laws governing a state) or to a person's physical constitution; also a daily walk taken for health
core_image: 国家的骨架与个人的骨架：一套支撑整体的基本规则
scene: The court struck down the law because it violated a constitutional right to free speech.
sceneCN: 这里 constitutional 是「宪法上的」（第 1 个义项：与国家宪法相关的）；句意：法院驳回了这部法律，因为它侵犯了宪法规定的言论自由权。图中可辨识物件：法庭、宪法文本、天平、法槌。

senses.title: Relating to a nation's constitution
senses.titleCN: 宪法的；与国家宪法相关的
senses.definition: connected with or permitted by the set of basic laws by which a country is governed
senses.definitionCN: 与治理国家的基本法律体系相关或被其允许的
senses.example: The new law was challenged on constitutional grounds.
senses.exampleCN: 这部新法律以违宪为由受到质疑。
senses.why: Latin constituere means 'to set up, establish'. The constitution is what sets up the state; constitutional describes what belongs to that founding framework.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 constituere 意为「建立、设立」。宪法是设立国家的东西；constitutional 描述的是属于这一立国框架的事物。

senses.title: Allowed or required by a constitution
senses.definition: permitted or required by the constitution of a country or organization
senses.definitionCN: 被国家或组织的宪法所允许或要求的
senses.example: Free elections are a constitutional requirement in most democracies.
senses.exampleCN: 自由选举是大多数民主国家的宪法要求。
senses.why: The suffix -al turns the noun constitution into an adjective meaning 'of or belonging to the constitution'.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -al 把名词 constitution 变成形容词，意为「属于宪法的」。

senses.title: Relating to a person's physical makeup
senses.definition: relating to the structure or condition of a person's body or mind
senses.definitionCN: 与一个人身心的结构或状况相关的
senses.example: He has a strong constitutional resistance to colds.
senses.exampleCN: 他体质强健，不易感冒。
senses.why: Constitution can also mean the natural make-up of the body. Constitutional here describes qualities that come from that inbuilt structure.
senses.whyCN: constitution 也可指身体的自然构成。此处 constitutional 描述的是来自这种内在结构的特质。

senses.title: Relating to the make-up of something
senses.definition: relating to the composition or essential structure of something
senses.definitionCN: 与某物的组成或本质结构相关的
senses.example: There are constitutional weaknesses in the design of the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的设计存在结构性弱点。
senses.why: The same root idea of 'what something is built from' applies to objects, not just people or states.
senses.whyCN: 「某物由什么构成」这一根义同样适用于物体，而不仅限于人或国家。

senses.title: A walk taken regularly for health
senses.definition: a walk taken regularly to keep or improve one's health
senses.definitionCN: 为保持或增进健康而定期进行的散步
senses.example: Grandpa takes his constitutional in the park every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 爷爷每天早上在公园作保健散步。
senses.why: A constitutional walk is one taken to benefit one's bodily constitution — the word shortens 'constitutional walk'.
senses.whyCN: 保健散步是为了有益于身体 constitution（体质）而进行的散步——这个词是 constitutional walk 的省略。

senses.title: Inherent in the basic structure
senses.definition: forming part of the essential nature or character of something
senses.definitionCN: 构成某物本质或特征的一部分的
senses.example: Courtesy is constitutional to his character.
senses.exampleCN: 礼貌是他性格中固有的特质。
senses.why: If a quality is constitutional, it is built into the fundamental make-up, like a clause written into a constitution.
senses.whyCN: 如果一种特质是 constitutional 的，它就被写入了基本构成，就像写进宪法的条款一样。

senses.title: Of or relating to constitutional law
senses.definition: belonging to the field of law that deals with constitutions
senses.definitionCN: 属于处理宪法的法律领域的
senses.example: She is a leading scholar of constitutional history.
senses.exampleCN: 她是宪法史领域的顶尖学者。
senses.why: This is the specialized sense used by legal scholars, narrowing the adjective to the study of constitutions.
senses.whyCN: 这是法律学者使用的专业义项，把这个形容词限定在宪法研究范围内。

senses.title: Beneficial to bodily health
senses.definition: tending to improve or preserve physical health
senses.definitionCN: 倾向于改善或保持身体健康的
senses.example: Sea air was once thought to be highly constitutional.
senses.exampleCN: 海风曾被认为极有益于健康。
senses.why: Something constitutional in this sense supports the body's constitution, much as a walk does.
senses.whyCN: 此义下的 constitutional 事物支持身体的体质，就像散步一样。

intro.en: Constitutional is an English adjective formed on the noun constitution, which comes from Latin constitutio. The chain is Latin verb → noun → adjective, with the English suffix -al.
intro.cn: constitutional 是在名词 constitution 上构成的英语形容词，constitution 来自拉丁 constitutio。链条是拉丁动词→名词→形容词，英语后缀是 -al。

items.en: constituere meant 'to set up, establish, appoint'. It is con- 'together' + statuere 'to place, set', from stare 'to stand'. The image is of placing things together so that a structure stands.
items.cn: constituere 意为「建立、设立、任命」。由 con-「一起」+ statuere「放置、设立」构成，statuere 来自 stare「站立」。画面是把东西放在一起，使一个结构站立起来。

items.en: The past participle constitutus gave the stem constitut-, used to build nouns. The sense shifts from the act of setting up to the result: what has been established.
items.cn: 过去分词 constitutus 提供了词干 constitut-，用于构成名词。意义从「设立的动作」转向「设立的结果」：已经建立的东西。

items.en: constitutio meant 'establishment, arrangement, decree, temperament'. It covered both political arrangements (a decree) and the natural arrangement of the body (temperament).
items.cn: constitutio 意为「建立、安排、法令、气质」。它既涵盖政治上的安排（法令），也涵盖身体的自然安排（气质）。

items.en: Old French constitution kept the political and physical senses. English borrowed it in the 14th century, at first for both law and bodily make-up.
items.cn: 古法语 constitution 保留了政治和身体两层意义。英语在 14 世纪借入，最初既指法律也指身体构成。

items.en: Around 1700, English added the suffix -al to make constitutional. At first it meant 'relating to the bodily constitution'; the political sense grew stronger after the American and French revolutions.
items.cn: 约 1700 年，英语加上后缀 -al 构成 constitutional。最初意为「与身体体质相关的」；政治意义在美国革命和法国革命之后逐渐增强。

items.en: Today constitutional is most common in law and politics, but the old bodily sense survives in the phrase 'a constitutional' (a health walk) and in references to physical constitution.
items.cn: 如今 constitutional 最常用于法律和政治，但旧的身体义在「a constitutional（保健散步）」和提及身体素质时仍然保留。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin root stare/statue; the second contains words close in political or bodily meaning.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁词根 stare/statue；第二组是政治或身体意义相近的词。

entries.definition: the system of laws by which a country is governed; also a person's bodily make-up
entries.definitionCN: 国家治理的法律体系；也指人的身体构成

entries.definition: relating to an institution (an established organization or custom); from instituere 'to establish'
entries.definitionCN: 与机构（已建立的组织或习俗）相关的；来自 instituere「建立」

entries.definition: a voting member of a district; forming part of a whole. From constituere, -ent suffix
entries.definitionCN: 选区的投票成员；构成整体的一部分。来自 constituere，后缀 -ent

entries.definition: relating to the law in general; broader than constitutional, which specifically concerns the constitution
entries.definitionCN: 与一般法律相关的；比 constitutional 更广，constitutional 特指宪法

entries.definition: relating to the essential structure of something; close to the 'bodily make-up' sense of constitutional
entries.definitionCN: 与某物的本质结构相关的；接近 constitutional 的「身体构成」义

entries.definition: forming a necessary base or core; a constitutional right is one kind of fundamental right
entries.definitionCN: 构成必要基础或核心的；宪法权利是基本权利的一种

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: con- 'together' + statuere 'to set up': the constitution sets up the state, and constitutional describes what that setup contains.
normal.cn: con-「一起」+ statuere「设立」：宪法设立国家，constitutional 描述这个设立所包含的东西。

normal.en: constitution is the noun (the document or the body); -al turns it into the adjective.
normal.cn: constitution 是名词（文件或身体）；-al 把它变成形容词。

normal.en: Constitutional walks were literally walks to improve one's constitution — the word shortens the phrase.
normal.cn: 保健散步字面就是改善体质的散步——这个词是短语的省略。

normal.en: in- flips the meaning: unconstitutional is what the constitution does not allow.
normal.cn: in- 翻转意义：unconstitutional 是宪法不允许的。

normal.en: institutional is the -al adjective of institution, just as constitutional is the -al adjective of constitution.
normal.cn: institutional 是 institution 的 -al 形容词，正如 constitutional 是 constitution 的 -al 形容词。

abstract.en: Think of a nation as a building: the constitution is the steel frame, and constitutional rights are the beams that cannot be removed.
abstract.cn: 把国家想象成一栋建筑：宪法是钢架，宪法权利是不能拆除的横梁。

abstract.en: Think of a person's health as their inner architecture; a constitutional walk gently exercises that structure.
abstract.cn: 把人的健康想象成内在的建筑结构；保健散步温和地锻炼这个结构。

abstract.en: Think of the word as 'constitution + all': everything belonging to the constitution is constitutional.
abstract.cn: 把这个词想成「constitution + all」：属于宪法的一切都是 constitutional。

examples.en: The court ruled that the new tax law violated a constitutional guarantee of equal treatment.
examples.cn: 法院裁定新税法违反了宪法保障的平等对待原则。

examples.en: She takes a thirty-minute constitutional along the river every evening.
examples.cn: 她每天傍晚沿河作三十分钟的保健散步。

examples.en: A constitutional weakness in the immune system makes him prone to infections.
examples.cn: 免疫系统的结构性弱点使他容易感染。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康斯提图神」——康（con）壮的体质由神（stitution）设立 → constitutional 宪法的、体质的

root: 拉丁 constituere「建立、设立」（con-「一起」+ statuere「放置」，statuere 来自 stare「站立」）；constitution 名词 + -al 形容词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one idea of 'what a thing is built on': the state is built on its constitution, the body on its constitution, and an object on its structural make-up.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享「事物建立在什么之上」这一观念：国家建立在宪法之上，身体建立在体质之上，物体建立在其结构构成之上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a frame or skeleton that holds a whole together.
core.cn: 核心意象：把整体撑住的框架或骨架。

branches.en: POLITICAL FRAMEWORK: the constitution and its study form the legal skeleton of a state.
branches.cn: 政治框架：宪法及其研究构成国家的法律骨架。

branches.en: PERMISSION BY THE FOUNDING TEXT: what the constitution allows is constitutional.
branches.cn: 立国文本的许可：宪法允许的就是合宪的。

branches.en: INNER BUILD OF A PERSON: the body's constitution gives natural strengths and weaknesses.
branches.cn: 人的内在构成：身体的体质带来天生的强弱。

branches.en: STRUCTURE OF A THING: constitutional weaknesses are built into the design; constitutional air supports health.
branches.cn: 事物的结构：结构性弱点内建于设计；有益健康的空气支持体质。

branches.en: WALK FOR THE BODY: a constitutional is a walk meant to serve the body's constitution.
branches.cn: 为身体而走：保健散步是为服务身体体质而进行的散步。

intro.en: Constitutional is built on the noun constitution with the productive adjective suffix -al. The deeper parts (con-, statuere) are fossilized inside the base.
intro.cn: constitutional 是在名词 constitution 上加能产的形容词后缀 -al 构成。更深层的部分（con-、statuere）已凝固在词基内部。

latinIntro.en: Latin statuere 'to set up' and its parent stare 'to stand' produced a huge family: state, statue, status, station, institute, constitute, destitute. The root appears as stat-, stit-, or stan-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 statuere「设立」及其母体 stare「站立」产生了庞大词族：state、statue、status、station、institute、constitute、destitute。词根以 stat-、stit- 或 stan- 形式出现。

items.meaning: the act or result of establishing; a body of fundamental laws; bodily make-up
items.meaningCN: 宪法；体质；建立（-tion 构成行为或结果名词）
items.example: The constitution guarantees freedom of religion.
items.exampleCN: 宪法保障宗教信仰自由。

items.meaning: of or belonging to a constitution
items.meaningCN: 宪法的；体质的（-al 形容词后缀）
items.example: The amendment is a constitutional right.
items.exampleCN: 这项修正案是一项宪法权利。

items.example: The court declared the law unconstitutional.

items.meaningCN: 合宪性（-ity 构成状态名词）
items.example: Lawyers debated the constitutionality of the measure.
items.exampleCN: 律师们辩论该措施的合宪性。

items.meaning: a voting member; forming part of a whole
items.meaningCN: 选民；组成的（-ent 形容词/名词后缀）
items.example: Each constituent has the right to vote.

items.meaning: to make up or form something
items.exampleCN: 十二个人组成一个陪审团。

items.example: The university is an old institution.
items.exampleCN: 这所大学是一个古老的机构。

items.example: A statue of the founder stands in the square.
items.exampleCN: 广场上矗立着创始人的雕像。

items.meaning: the legal or social position of a person
items.example: The status of the agreement is still unclear.
items.exampleCN: 该协议的地位仍不清楚。

definition_zh: 建造；建筑物；构造；释义；造句
definition_en: the process of building something; the thing built; the way something is put together; the interpretation of a law or word; a sentence structure
core_image: 把材料一层层叠起来，搭成一个整体
scene: The construction of the new bridge took three years and employed hundreds of workers.
sceneCN: 这里 construction 是「建造」（第 1 个义项：建造的过程）；句意：新桥的建造花了三年，雇用了数百名工人。图中可辨识物件：桥梁、起重机、钢架、工人、安全帽。

pos.zh: 建造；建筑物；构造；释义；句子结构

senses.title: The act or process of building
senses.definition: the activity or process of building things such as houses, roads, or bridges
senses.definitionCN: 建造房屋、道路、桥梁等事物的活动或过程
senses.example: Construction of the dam began last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 大坝的建设始于去年春天。
senses.why: Latin struere means 'to pile up, build'. Construction is the noun of the action of piling materials together.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 struere 意为「堆积、建造」。construction 是把材料堆在一起这一动作的名词。

senses.title: A thing that has been built
senses.definition: something that has been built or put together
senses.definitionCN: 被建造或组合起来的东西
senses.example: The old construction still stands after two hundred years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座古老的建筑两百年后依然矗立。
senses.why: The same noun shifts from the process to the product: what is constructed is a construction.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词从过程转向产物：被建造的东西就是 construction。

senses.title: The way something is built or arranged
senses.definition: the manner in which something is built, arranged, or organized
senses.definitionCN: 某物被建造、安排或组织的方式
senses.example: The construction of the sentence is unusual.
senses.exampleCN: 这个句子的结构很不寻常。
senses.why: When applied to language or ideas, construction means how the parts are arranged to form a whole.
senses.whyCN: 当用于语言或观念时，construction 指各部分被安排成整体的方式。

senses.title: An interpretation of a law or text
senses.definition: the way in which a law, rule, or statement is understood or interpreted
senses.definitionCN: 对法律、规则或陈述的理解或解释方式
senses.example: The judge adopted a narrow construction of the statute.
senses.exampleCN: 法官对该法规采取了狭义解释。
senses.why: In legal use, a construction is how one 'builds' the meaning of a text from its words.
senses.whyCN: 在法律用法中，construction 是如何从文本的词语中「构建」出意义。

senses.title: A phrase or sentence structure
senses.definition: a particular arrangement of words forming a phrase or sentence
senses.definitionCN: 构成短语或句子的词语的特定排列
senses.example: This is a common construction in academic writing.
senses.exampleCN: 这是学术写作中常见的句法结构。
senses.why: Grammarians speak of a sentence's construction the way builders speak of a building's.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家谈论句子的 construction，就像建筑工人谈论建筑的结构一样。

senses.title: A created concept or theory
senses.definition: an idea or theory that is created rather than naturally existing
senses.definitionCN: 被创造出来而非自然存在的观念或理论
senses.example: The nation-state is a historical construction.
senses.exampleCN: 民族国家是一个历史的建构。
senses.why: In social science, a construction is something society builds, not something found in nature.
senses.whyCN: 在社会科学中，construction 是社会建构的东西，而非自然界中存在的。

senses.title: The arrangement of lines in art
senses.definition: the arrangement of forms and lines in a painting or drawing
senses.definitionCN: 绘画中形体和线条的安排
senses.example: The painting's construction draws the eye to the center.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画的构图把视线引向中心。
senses.why: Art critics borrow the building metaphor: a picture is constructed from shapes and lines.
senses.whyCN: 艺术批评家借用建筑的隐喻：一幅画由形状和线条构成。

senses.title: A copy or model made for study
senses.definition: a model or reconstruction made for study or display
senses.definitionCN: 为研究或展示而制作的模型或复制品
senses.example: The museum displayed a construction of the ancient ship.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆展示了那艘古船的模型。
senses.why: Here construction means a built representation, something put together to show how the original looked.
senses.whyCN: 此处 construction 指搭建的再现物，是为了展示原物样貌而组合起来的东西。

intro.en: Construction comes from Latin constructio, from construere 'to pile together'. The root struere appears in many English words about building and arranging.
intro.cn: construction 来自拉丁 constructio，源自 construere「堆在一起」。词根 struere 出现在许多关于建造和安排的英语词中。

items.en: struere meant 'to heap up, pile, build'. It is the base of a wide family about putting things in order.
items.cn: struere 意为「堆积、堆起、建造」。它是一个关于整理事物的庞大家族的词根。

items.en: con- adds 'together'. construere is 'to pile together', i.e., to assemble materials into a structure.
items.cn: con- 加上「一起」。construere 就是「堆在一起」，即把材料组装成结构。

items.en: constructus, the past participle, supplied the stem construct- used in the noun and adjective.
items.cn: 过去分词 constructus 提供了用于名词和形容词的词干 construct-。

items.en: constructio meant 'a putting together, building'. It entered French and then English.
items.cn: constructio 意为「组合、建造」。它进入法语，再进入英语。

items.en: Old French construction kept the building sense. English borrowed it in the 14th century.
items.cn: 古法语 construction 保留了建造义。英语在 14 世纪借入。

items.en: Over time the word moved from physical building to the building of sentences, meanings, theories, and social categories.
items.cn: 随着时间推移，该词从物理建造扩展到句子、意义、理论和社会类别的建构。

note.en: The first group shares the root struere; the second contains words near in meaning of building or interpretation.
note.cn: 第一组共享词根 struere；第二组是建造或解释意义相近的词。

entries.definition: to build or put together; the verb from which construction is formed
entries.definitionCN: 建造；组合；construction 所源自的动词

entries.definition: the act of destroying; de- 'down' + struere, the opposite of construction
entries.definitionCN: 破坏；de-「向下」+ struere，与 construction 相反

entries.definition: teaching or an order; in- 'into' + struere, building knowledge into the mind
entries.definitionCN: 教导；指令；in-「向内」+ struere，把知识建入头脑

entries.definition: a structure with walls and a roof; more concrete than construction, which can be abstract
entries.definitionCN: 有墙有顶的结构；比 construction 更具体，construction 可抽象

entries.definition: the way parts are organized; overlaps with the 'arrangement' sense of construction
entries.definitionCN: 各部分组织的方式；与 construction 的「安排」义重叠

entries.definition: the act of explaining the meaning of something; close to the legal sense of construction
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物意义的行为；接近 construction 的法律义

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: con- 'together' + struere 'to pile': construction is piling materials together.
normal.cn: con-「一起」+ struere「堆积」：construction 就是把材料堆在一起。

normal.en: construct is the verb; construction is the noun of the action or its result.
normal.cn: construct 是动词；construction 是动作或其结果的名词。

normal.en: destruction (de-) is the opposite of construction (con-): tearing down vs. building up.
normal.cn: destruction（de-）是 construction（con-）的反面：拆除 vs. 建造。

normal.en: instruction builds knowledge into the mind with the same root struere.
normal.cn: instruction 用同一个词根 struere 把知识建入头脑。

normal.en: A sentence's construction is how it is built from words, like a building from bricks.
normal.cn: 句子的 construction 是它如何由词语构成，就像建筑由砖块构成。

abstract.en: Think of a wall rising brick by brick: each brick is a part, and construction is the whole rising.
abstract.cn: 想象一堵墙一砖一砖地升起：每块砖是一个部分，construction 是升起的整体。

abstract.en: Think of a sentence as a small building; its construction is its architecture.
abstract.cn: 把句子想象成一栋小建筑；它的 construction 就是它的建筑设计。

abstract.en: Think of laws as buildings too: a construction is how you erect a meaning from the text.
abstract.cn: 把法律也想象成建筑：construction 是你如何从文本中搭建出意义。

examples.en: The construction of the new hospital will be finished next year.
examples.cn: 新医院的建设将于明年完工。

examples.en: Under the judge's construction of the law, the contract was valid.
examples.cn: 根据法官对法律的解释，该合同是有效的。

examples.en: This essay has poor sentence construction in several paragraphs.
examples.cn: 这篇文章有几个段落的句子结构很差。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康斯抓客神」——康（con）师傅抓起砖块（struere）堆成楼 → construction 建造、结构

root: 拉丁 construere「堆积、建造」（con-「一起」+ struere「堆积」）；construct- 词干 + -tion 名词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all grow from 'piling parts together': physical buildings, sentence structures, legal meanings, and social ideas are all constructions.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都从「把部分堆在一起」生长而来：物理建筑、句子结构、法律意义和社会观念都是 construction。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: layers of material stacked until a whole stands.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层层材料堆叠，直到整体立起。

branches.en: PHYSICAL BUILDING: the process and the product of putting materials together.
branches.cn: 物理建造：把材料组合起来的过程和产物。

branches.en: LINGUISTIC STRUCTURE: how words and sentences are built from parts.
branches.cn: 语言结构：词语和句子如何由部分构成。

branches.en: LEGAL INTERPRETATION: meaning is constructed from the words of a text.
branches.cn: 法律解释：意义从文本词语中建构出来。

branches.en: SOCIAL CONSTRUCTION: ideas and categories are built by society.
branches.cn: 社会建构：观念和类别由社会建构。

branches.en: REPRESENTATIONAL BUILD: a picture's composition or a model's structure.
branches.cn: 再现性建构：绘画的构图或模型的结构。

intro.en: Construction is the Latin-stem noun from construere. The suffix -tion marks the action or result; con- and struere are the fossilized inner parts.
intro.cn: construction 是来自 construere 的拉丁词干名词。后缀 -tion 标记动作或结果；con- 和 struere 是凝固的内部部分。

latinIntro.en: Latin struere 'to pile, build' produced a large family: structure, construct, destruct, instruct, obstruct, instrument. The root appears as stru-, struct-, or stroy-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 struere「堆积、建造」产生了大家族：structure、construct、destruct、instruct、obstruct、instrument。词根以 stru-、struct- 或 stroy- 形式出现。

items.example: They plan to construct a new bridge.
items.exampleCN: 他们计划建造一座新桥。

items.meaning: the act or result of building

items.meaningCN: 建设性的（-ive 形容词后缀）
items.exampleCN: 她提出了建设性的批评。
暴风雨造成了广泛的破坏。

items.example: He was charged with obstruction of justice.
The structure of the building is sound.

definition_zh: 建设性的；有益的；积极的
definition_en: helping to develop or improve something; useful and positive rather than negative or destructive
core_image: 不只是指出问题，还递上砖块一起盖
scene: Instead of complaining, she offered constructive suggestions for improving the project.
sceneCN: 这里 constructive 是「建设性的」（第 1 个义项：有助于改进的）；句意：她没有抱怨，而是提出了改进项目的建设性建议。图中可辨识物件：项目蓝图、便签、铅笔、讨论的人。

pos.zh: 建设性的；有益的；积极的

senses.title: Helping to improve or develop
senses.definition: helping to improve, develop, or make something better
senses.definitionCN: 有助于改进、发展或使某物变得更好的
senses.example: The meeting ended with some constructive proposals.
senses.exampleCN: 会议以一些建设性的提案结束。
senses.why: Latin struere 'to build' + -ive 'having the quality of': constructive has the quality of building up, not tearing down.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 struere「建造」+ -ive「具有……性质的」：constructive 具有建设而非拆除的性质。

senses.title: Useful and positive rather than critical
senses.titleCN: 积极正面的而非单纯批评的
senses.definition: useful, helpful, and positive, especially in dealing with a problem
senses.definitionCN: 有用、有帮助且积极的，尤指在处理问题时
senses.example: Try to be constructive when you review her work.
senses.exampleCN: 评审她的作品时尽量持建设性态度。
senses.why: A constructive comment builds the person or project up; a merely destructive one pulls it down.
senses.whyCN: 建设性的评论把人或项目扶起来；单纯破坏性的则把它推倒。

senses.title: Having a useful purpose
senses.definition: serving a useful or helpful purpose
senses.definitionCN: 具有有用或有帮助的目的的
senses.example: It was a constructive use of the waiting time.
senses.exampleCN: 这是对等待时间的有效利用。
senses.why: When time or effort is constructive, it builds something of value rather than being wasted.
senses.whyCN: 当时间或努力是 constructive 的，它建起了有价值的东西，而非被浪费。

senses.title: Relating to construction in law
senses.definition: in law, imputed or inferred by interpretation rather than directly stated
senses.definitionCN: 在法律中，通过解释推定而非直接陈述的
senses.example: The court found constructive trust over the property.
senses.exampleCN: 法院认定对该财产存在推定信托。
senses.why: In law, constructive means 'built by interpretation' — the law constructs a duty or right from the circumstances.
senses.whyCN: 在法律中，constructive 意为「由解释建构的」——法律从情境中建构出义务或权利。

senses.title: Of or relating to building
senses.definition: relating to the act or process of construction
senses.definitionCN: 与建造行为或过程相关的
senses.example: The constructive phase of the project lasted two years.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目的建造阶段持续了两年。
senses.why: This is the literal sense, directly referring to physical building.
senses.whyCN: 这是字面义，直接指物理建造。

senses.title: Creating rather than merely describing
senses.definition: involving the creation of new ideas or structures rather than just analysis
senses.definitionCN: 涉及创造新观念或结构，而非仅仅分析
senses.example: His work is highly constructive, proposing novel frameworks.
senses.exampleCN: 他的工作极富建构性，提出了新颖的框架。
senses.why: Constructive thought builds new structures of understanding.
senses.whyCN: 建构性思维建起新的理解结构。

senses.title: Cooperative and solution-oriented
senses.definition: willing to work together to find solutions
senses.definitionCN: 愿意共同努力寻找解决方案的
senses.example: Both sides took a constructive stance in the talks.
senses.exampleCN: 双方在谈判中都采取了建设性立场。
senses.why: A constructive stance builds toward agreement rather than blocking it.
senses.whyCN: 建设性立场朝向达成共识而非阻碍共识。

senses.title: Beneficial to growth
senses.definition: promoting healthy growth or development
senses.definitionCN: 促进健康成长或发展的
senses.example: Constructive play helps young children learn.
senses.exampleCN: 建设性的游戏帮助幼儿学习。
senses.why: Activities are constructive when they help a child build skills and understanding.
senses.whyCN: 当活动帮助儿童建立技能和理解时，它们就是 constructive 的。

intro.en: Constructive is the -ive adjective from the verb construct, from Latin construere. It shifted from 'relating to building' to 'helping to build up' in a figurative sense.
intro.cn: constructive 是来自动词 construct 的 -ive 形容词，construct 源自拉丁 construere。它从「与建造相关」转为比喻义「有助于建设」。

items.en: struere 'to pile, build' is the base; con- adds 'together'. construere = 'to build together'.
items.cn: struere「堆积、建造」是词根；con- 加上「一起」。construere =「一起建造」。

items.en: English construct came directly from Latin constructus in the 15th century, meaning 'to build'.
items.cn: 英语 construct 在 15 世纪直接来自拉丁 constructus，意为「建造」。

items.en: The Latin suffix -ivus, borrowed as -ive, means 'having the nature of'. constructive = 'having the nature of building'.
items.cn: 拉丁后缀 -ivus，借入为 -ive，意为「具有……性质的」。constructive =「具有建造性质的」。

items.en: Constructive first appeared in English in the 1670s, at first meaning 'relating to construction'.
items.cn: constructive 于 1670 年代首次出现在英语中，最初意为「与建造相关的」。

items.en: By the 19th century, the word was used figuratively for anything that builds up, improves, or promotes development.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪，该词被比喻地用于任何建设、改进或促进发展的事物。

items.en: The legal sense 'imputed by construction' developed in the 18th century, from the idea of building a legal meaning.
items.cn: 法律义「由解释推定的」发展于 18 世纪，源自建构法律意义的观念。

note.en: The first group shares the root struere; the second contains words near in meaning of helpfulness or positivity.
note.cn: 第一组共享词根 struere；第二组是有益或积极意义相近的词。

entries.definition: to build or make something; the verb from which constructive comes
entries.definitionCN: 建造；制作；constructive 所源自的动词

entries.definition: causing damage or harm; the opposite of constructive, from destruere 'to tear down'
entries.definitionCN: 造成破坏或伤害的；constructive 的反义词，来自 destruere「拆除」

entries.definition: giving useful information; from instruere 'to build into (the mind)'
entries.definitionCN: 提供有用信息的；来自 instruere「建入（头脑）」

entries.definition: giving help; a more general word than constructive, which stresses building up
entries.definitionCN: 给予帮助的；比 constructive 更通用，constructive 强调建设

entries.definition: optimistic or encouraging; constructive adds the idea of building something specific
entries.definitionCN: 乐观或鼓励的；constructive 还包含建设具体事物的含义

entries.definition: producing good results; close to constructive but stresses output rather than building
entries.definitionCN: 产生好结果的；接近 constructive，但强调产出而非建造

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: construct (build) + -ive (having the quality): constructive = having the quality of building up.
normal.cn: construct（建造）+ -ive（具有……性质）：constructive = 具有建设性质的。

normal.en: The opposite pair is constructive vs. destructive: build up vs. tear down.
normal.cn: 反义词对是 constructive vs. destructive：建设 vs. 拆除。

normal.en: instructive (teach) uses the same root: building knowledge into the mind.
normal.cn: instructive（教导的）使用同一词根：把知识建入头脑。

normal.en: Constructive criticism builds the person up; destructive criticism tears them down.
normal.cn: 建设性批评把人扶起来；破坏性批评把人推倒。

normal.en: The legal sense comes from 'construction' of the law: building a meaning.
normal.cn: 法律义来自法律的「construction（解释）」：建构意义。

abstract.en: Think of a builder handing you bricks and a plan instead of just pointing at the broken wall: that's constructive.
abstract.cn: 想象一个建筑工人递给你砖块和图纸，而不是只指着破墙说问题：这就是 constructive。

abstract.en: Think of two paths: one labeled destructive (leading to a pile of rubble), one constructive (leading to a finished house).
abstract.cn: 想象两条路：一条标 destructive（通向瓦砾堆），一条标 constructive（通向建成的房子）。

abstract.en: Think of the suffix -ive as 'tending to': constructive = tending to construct.
abstract.cn: 把后缀 -ive 想成「倾向于」：constructive = 倾向于建造。

examples.en: Thank you for your constructive feedback; it really helped me improve.
examples.cn: 感谢你的建设性反馈，确实帮我改进了。

examples.en: The two countries held constructive talks on climate policy.
examples.cn: 两国就气候政策举行了建设性会谈。

examples.en: A constructive trust was imposed to prevent unjust enrichment.
examples.cn: 法院施加了推定信托以防止不当得利。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康斯抓客踢我」——别踢我，递块砖（construct）一起盖 → constructive 建设性的

root: 拉丁 construere「堆积、建造」（con-「一起」+ struere「堆积」）；construct- 词干 + -ive「具有……性质的」形容词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all mean 'building something up': a project, a person, a legal meaning, or a child's development.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都表示「建起某物」：一个项目、一个人、一个法律意义，或一个孩子的成长。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand offering bricks and a plan, not just criticism.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只递上砖块和图纸的手，而不只是批评。

branches.en: IMPROVEMENT: constructive words and actions help something get better.
branches.cn: 改进：建设性的言行帮助事物变好。

branches.en: SOLUTION-FOCUSED: constructive effort and stance build toward answers.
branches.cn: 着眼解决：建设性的努力和立场朝向答案。

branches.en: LEGAL CONSTRUCTION: the law builds a duty or right from the facts.
branches.cn: 法律建构：法律从事实中建构义务或权利。

branches.en: CREATION: constructive phases or thought build new structures.
branches.cn: 创造：建设性的阶段或思想建起新结构。

branches.en: GROWTH: constructive activities help development.
branches.cn: 成长：建设性的活动帮助发展。

intro.en: Constructive is the -ive adjective of construct. The suffix -ive is productive; con- and struere are fossilized inside the base.
intro.cn: constructive 是 construct 的 -ive 形容词。后缀 -ive 有能产性；con- 和 struere 凝固在词基内部。

latinIntro.en: Latin struere 'to build' and its family (construct, destruct, instruct) all appear as -struct- in English. The -ive suffix comes from Latin -ivus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 struere「建造」及其家族（construct、destruct、instruct）在英语中都以 -struct- 出现。-ive 后缀来自拉丁 -ivus。

items.example: They will construct a new road.

items.meaning: having the quality of building up
items.meaningCN: 建设性的（-ive 形容词后缀）
建设性地（-ly 副词后缀）
items.example: He responded constructively to the criticism.
items.exampleCN: 他对批评作出了建设性回应。

items.example: We admired the constructiveness of her approach.
items.exampleCN: 我们赞赏她方法的建设性。
这场讲座极具教育意义。
建筑施工是嘈杂的工作。
他们重建了那座老剧院。

definition_en: a meeting in which people discuss something and seek advice; the process of asking for someone's opinion; a meeting of medical specialists
core_image: 围坐一桌，把问题摆出来一起商量
scene: The manager held a consultation with the team before making the final decision.
sceneCN: 这里 consultation 是「磋商」（第 1 个义项：讨论并征求意见的会议）；句意：经理在做最终决定前与团队进行了磋商。图中可辨识物件：会议桌、文件、讨论的人、笔记本。

senses.title: A discussion to seek advice
senses.definition: a discussion between people in which advice is sought or opinions exchanged
senses.definitionCN: 人们之间寻求建议或交换意见的讨论
senses.example: The decision was made after consultation with experts.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定是在咨询专家后做出的。
senses.why: Latin consulere means 'to take counsel, deliberate'. consultation is the noun of that deliberative meeting.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 consulere 意为「商议、斟酌」。consultation 是这种商议会议的名词。

senses.title: The act of seeking professional advice
senses.definition: the act of asking a professional person for advice
senses.definitionCN: 向专业人士征求意见的行为
senses.example: You should seek a consultation with a lawyer.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该咨询律师。
senses.why: When you consult a professional, the meeting is a consultation.
senses.whyCN: 当你咨询专业人士时，这次会面就是 consultation。

senses.title: A meeting of medical specialists
senses.definition: a meeting of doctors or specialists to discuss a patient's case
senses.definitionCN: 医生或专家讨论病人病例的会议
senses.example: The surgeons held a consultation before the operation.
senses.exampleCN: 外科医生在手术前进行了会诊。
senses.why: In medicine, a consultation is when specialists put their heads together on a case.
senses.whyCN: 在医学中，consultation 是专家们一起讨论一个病例。

senses.title: The process of asking for public views
senses.definition: the process of asking the public for their opinions before making a decision
senses.definitionCN: 在做决定前征求公众意见的过程
senses.example: The new policy is now open for public consultation.
senses.exampleCN: 新政策现正接受公众咨询。
senses.why: Governments hold consultations to gather views before acting.
senses.whyCN: 政府举行咨询以在行动前收集意见。

senses.title: A reference or check of a source
senses.definition: the act of referring to a book, map, or source for information
senses.definitionCN: 查阅书籍、地图或资料以获取信息的行为
senses.example: Consultation of the records revealed the error.
senses.exampleCN: 查阅记录后发现了错误。
senses.why: When you consult a reference work, the act is a consultation.
senses.whyCN: 当你查阅参考书时，这个行为就是 consultation。

senses.title: A period set aside for discussion
senses.definition: a period of time during which opinions are gathered
senses.definitionCN: 收集意见的时间段
senses.example: The consultation runs for thirty days.
senses.exampleCN: 咨询期为三十天。
senses.why: A consultation period is the window during which people can give their views.
senses.whyCN: 咨询期是人们可以发表意见的时间窗口。

senses.title: A formal conference between parties
senses.definition: a formal meeting between parties to discuss terms or resolve issues
senses.definitionCN: 当事方之间讨论条款或解决问题的正式会议
senses.example: The lawyers arranged a consultation before the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 律师们在审判前安排了一次会商。
senses.why: In legal settings, a consultation is a formal discussion to align strategy.
senses.whyCN: 在法律场景中，consultation 是协调策略的正式讨论。

senses.title: Advice given as a result of discussion
senses.definition: the advice or opinion resulting from such a discussion
senses.definitionCN: 这种讨论产生的建议或意见
senses.example: He followed the consultation of his mentors.
senses.exampleCN: 他听从了导师们的咨询意见。
senses.why: By metonymy, the word can mean the advice itself, not just the meeting.
senses.whyCN: 通过转喻，该词可指建议本身，而不仅是会议。

intro.en: Consultation comes from Latin consultatio, from consultare, a frequentative of consulere 'to take counsel'. The root idea is sitting together to weigh a matter.
intro.cn: consultation 来自拉丁 consultatio，源自 consultare，即 consulere「商议」的反复体。核心意象是坐在一起权衡一件事。

items.en: consulere meant 'to take counsel, consult, deliberate'. It is linked to consul, a Roman magistrate, and to sedere 'to sit'.
items.cn: consulere 意为「商议、咨询、斟酌」。它与罗马执政官 consul 以及 sedere「坐」有关联。

items.en: consultare is the frequentative of consulere, meaning 'to consult repeatedly or carefully'.
items.cn: consultare 是 consulere 的反复体，意为「反复或仔细地商议」。

items.en: consultatio meant 'deliberation, consultation'. It was formed from consultare + -tio.
items.cn: consultatio 意为「商议、咨询」。由 consultare + -tio 构成。

items.en: French consultation and English consultation were borrowed in the 15th century, keeping the sense of deliberation.
items.cn: 法语 consultation 和英语 consultation 在 15 世纪借入，保留了商议的意义。

items.en: The word broadened from private deliberation to include public and professional meetings.
items.cn: 该词从私下斟酌扩展到包括公众和专业会议。

items.en: Today consultation appears in law, medicine, government, and everyday advice-seeking.
items.cn: 如今 consultation 出现在法律、医学、政府和日常咨询中。

note.en: The first group shares consulere; the second contains words near in meaning of discussion or advice.
note.cn: 第一组共享 consulere；第二组是讨论或建议意义相近的词。

entries.definition: to seek information or advice from; the verb behind consultation
entries.definitionCN: 向……寻求信息或建议；consultation 背后的动词

entries.definition: a person who gives professional advice; consult + -ant
entries.definitionCN: 提供专业建议的人；consult + -ant

entries.definition: advice or a lawyer; from the same Latin consulere via Old French
entries.definitionCN: 建议或律师；同源，经古法语进入

entries.definition: talking about something to reach a decision; consultation adds the element of seeking advice
entries.definitionCN: 讨论某事以达成决定；consultation 还包含征求意见的成分

entries.definition: a coming together of people; a consultation is a specific kind of meeting
entries.definitionCN: 人们的聚会；consultation 是一种特定的会议

entries.definition: an opinion given as guidance; consultation is the meeting that produces advice
entries.definitionCN: 作为指导给出的意见；consultation 是产生建议的会议

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: consulere 'to take counsel': consultation is the meeting where counsel is taken.
normal.cn: consulere「商议」：consultation 是进行商议的会议。

normal.en: consult is the verb; consultation is the noun of the action or the meeting.
normal.cn: consult 是动词；consultation 是动作或会议的名词。

normal.en: consultant is the person consulted; consultation is the event.
normal.cn: consultant 是被咨询的人；consultation 是这个事件。

normal.en: counsel and consul share the same root: sitting together to decide.
normal.cn: counsel 和 consul 共享词根：坐在一起做决定。

normal.en: Public consultation is government asking the people before deciding.
normal.cn: 公众咨询是政府在决定前征求民众意见。

abstract.en: Think of people sitting around a table, each turning a question over: that's consultation.
abstract.cn: 想象人们围坐桌边，每个人都在反复掂量一个问题：这就是 consultation。

abstract.en: Think of the consul (Roman official) calling the senate: consultation descends from that scene.
abstract.cn: 想象罗马执政官召集元老院：consultation 就源自那个场景。

abstract.en: Think of a doctor's second opinion: a medical consultation is specialists weighing a case together.
abstract.cn: 想象医生的二次诊断：医疗会诊是专家一起权衡病例。

examples.en: The school board held a consultation with parents before changing the policy.
examples.cn: 校董会在改变政策前与家长进行了磋商。

examples.en: After a consultation with the surgeon, she decided to have the operation.
examples.cn: 与外科医生会诊后，她决定接受手术。

examples.en: The plan is now open for public consultation until the end of the month.
examples.cn: 该计划现正接受公众咨询，至月底截止。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all involve sitting together to weigh a question: with experts, doctors, the public, or reference books.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: people seated around a table, turning a question over together.
core.cn: 核心意象：人们围坐桌边，一起反复掂量一个问题。

branches.en: DELIBERATIVE MEETING: people meet to weigh and decide.
branches.cn: 商议会议：人们聚会权衡并做决定。

branches.en: PROFESSIONAL ADVICE: seeking and receiving expert guidance.
branches.cn: 专业建议：寻求并接受专家指导。

branches.en: MEDICAL CONFERENCE: specialists discuss a patient.
branches.cn: 医疗会诊：专家讨论病人。

branches.en: PUBLIC INPUT: government or groups gather views.
branches.cn: 公众参与：政府或团体收集意见。

branches.en: REFERENCE CHECK: consulting a source for facts.
branches.cn: 资料查阅：查阅来源获取事实。

latinIntro.en: Latin consulere 'to take counsel' produced consul, consulere, consultare, and the English family consult, consultant, consultation, counsel.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 consulere「商议」产生了 consul、consulere、consultare，以及英语词族 consult、consultant、consultation、counsel。

items.meaning: a person who gives professional advice

items.example: He took counsel from his lawyer.

definition_zh: 污染；弄脏；玷污；（语言）感染
definition_en: the process of making something dirty, impure, or harmful by adding unwanted or dangerous substances; also figurative pollution
core_image: 一滴黑墨落入清水，把纯净弄脏
scene: The contamination of the river forced the town to close its water supply.
sceneCN: 这里 contamination 是「污染」（第 1 个义项：使变脏的过程）；句意：河流的污染迫使该镇关闭供水。图中可辨识物件：河流、排污管、死鱼、水龙头、警告标志。

senses.title: The process of making something impure
senses.definition: the action or process of making a substance or place dirty or no longer pure
senses.definitionCN: 使物质或地方变脏或不再纯净的行为或过程
senses.example: Industrial waste caused the contamination of the groundwater.
senses.exampleCN: 工业废料造成了地下水的污染。
senses.why: Latin tangere 'to touch' + con-: contaminare meant 'to touch together', then 'to make impure by contact'.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 tangere「触摸」+ con-：contaminare 意为「一起触摸」，后转为「因接触而弄脏」。

senses.title: The state of being polluted
senses.definition: the condition of having been made dirty, impure, or harmful
senses.definitionCN: 已被弄脏、不纯或有害的状态
senses.example: Tests showed contamination in the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 检测显示土壤受到污染。
senses.why: The noun shifts from the process to the resulting state.
senses.whyCN: 该名词从过程转向结果状态。

senses.title: A polluting substance or agent
senses.definition: a substance that makes something impure or dangerous
senses.definitionCN: 使某物不纯或危险的物质
senses.example: The contamination was traced to a leaking tank.
senses.exampleCN: 污染物被追溯到一个泄漏的储罐。
senses.why: By metonymy, the cause (the substance) takes the name of the effect (contamination).
senses.whyCN: 通过转喻，原因（物质）借用了结果（contamination）的名称。

senses.title: Corruption of purity by contact
senses.definition: the process by which something good or pure is made less pure by harmful influence
senses.definitionCN: 好的或纯净的事物因有害影响而变得不纯的过程
senses.example: The scandal led to the contamination of the whole administration.
senses.exampleCN: 丑闻导致了整个政府的腐化。
senses.why: Figuratively, contamination is the spreading of impurity from one thing to another.
senses.whyCN: 比喻地，contamination 是不纯从一物扩散到另一物。

senses.title: Infection in language change
senses.definition: in linguistics, the process by which one word's form influences another's
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中，一个词的形式影响另一个词的形式的过程
senses.example: The form 'paternal' shows contamination from Latin pater.
senses.exampleCN: paternal 的形式显示出受拉丁 pater 的语言感染。
senses.why: In philology, contamination is when a word is 'touched' and altered by a related word.
senses.whyCN: 在语文学中，contamination 是一个词被相关词「接触」并改变。

senses.title: Nuclear or radioactive pollution
senses.definition: the pollution caused by radioactive material
senses.definitionCN: 由放射性物质造成的污染
senses.example: The area remains unsafe due to radioactive contamination.
senses.exampleCN: 由于放射性污染，该地区仍然不安全。
senses.why: A specialized use: the unwanted 'touch' of radiation on an area.
senses.whyCN: 一种专门用法：辐射对一个地区的不必要「接触」。

senses.title: The introduction of harmful elements
senses.definition: the act of introducing harmful or unwanted elements into something
senses.definitionCN: 把有害或不需要的成分引入某物的行为
senses.example: The contamination of the data set skewed the results.
senses.exampleCN: 数据集的掺入干扰使结果失真。
senses.why: In research, contamination means unwanted data getting into the sample.
senses.whyCN: 在研究中，contamination 指不需要的数据进入样本。

senses.title: Moral or spiritual pollution
senses.definition: the process of making something morally or spiritually impure
senses.definitionCN: 使某物在道德或精神上不纯的过程
senses.example: Critics warned of the contamination of young minds by violence.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者警告暴力会污染青少年心灵。
senses.why: The oldest figurative sense: impurity spreading from one mind to another.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的比喻义：不纯从一个心灵蔓延到另一个心灵。

intro.en: Contamination comes from Latin contaminatio, from contaminare 'to defile'. The root is tangere 'to touch', via the idea of one thing touching and soiling another.
intro.cn: contamination 来自拉丁 contaminatio，源自 contaminare「玷污」。词根是 tangere「触摸」，通过一物接触并弄脏另一物的意象而来。

items.en: tangere meant 'to touch'. Many English words come from it: tangent, tangible, contact, contagion, contaminate.
items.cn: tangere 意为「触摸」。许多英语词源自它：tangent、tangible、contact、contagion、contaminate。

items.en: The prefix com- (con-) adds 'together'. contaminare is 'to touch together', and by extension 'to make impure by contact'.
items.cn: 前缀 com-（con-）加上「一起」。contaminare 是「一起触摸」，引申为「因接触而弄脏」。

items.en: contaminatus, past participle of contaminare, gave the stem used in English contaminate.
items.cn: contaminatus，contaminare 的过去分词，提供了英语 contaminate 所用的词干。

items.en: contaminatio meant 'a defiling, polluting'. It was borrowed into French and English.
items.cn: contaminatio 意为「玷污、污染」。它被借入法语和英语。

items.en: Contamination entered English in the 15th century, first in the moral sense, then the physical.
items.cn: contamination 在 15 世纪进入英语，先是道德义，后是物理义。

items.en: Modern use is strongest in environmental science, medicine, and nuclear safety, where 'impurity' is measurable.
items.cn: 现代用法最强势于环境科学、医学和核安全领域，其中「不纯」是可测量的。

note.en: The first group shares tangere; the second contains words near in meaning of pollution or impurity.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tangere；第二组是污染或不纯意义相近的词。

entries.definition: to make something dirty or harmful; the verb behind contamination
entries.definitionCN: 使某物变脏或有害；contamination 背后的动词

entries.definition: the spread of disease by contact; from con- + tagere (from tangere)
entries.definitionCN: 疾病通过接触传播；来自 con- + tagere（源自 tangere）

entries.definition: able to be touched; from tangere, the opposite of abstract
entries.definitionCN: 可触摸的；来自 tangere，与抽象相反

entries.definition: the presence of harmful substances in the environment; broader and more common than contamination
entries.definitionCN: 环境中有害物质的存在；比 contamination 更广更常见

entries.definition: a substance that makes something impure; a more general term than contamination
entries.definitionCN: 使某物不纯的物质；比 contamination 更通用的术语

entries.definition: moral decay or dishonesty; close to the figurative sense of contamination
entries.definitionCN: 道德败坏或不诚实；接近 contamination 的比喻义

normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: con- 'together' + tangere 'to touch': contamination happens when one thing touches and soils another.
normal.cn: con-「一起」+ tangere「触摸」：当一物接触并弄脏另一物时就发生 contamination。

normal.en: contaminate is the verb; contamination is the noun of the action or state.
normal.cn: contaminate 是动词；contamination 是动作或状态的名词。

normal.en: contagion is disease spread by touching — same root, different idea.
normal.cn: contagion 是通过接触传播的疾病——同词根，不同含义。

normal.en: tangible means touchable; contamination is the bad kind of touching.
normal.cn: tangible 意为可触摸的；contamination 是坏的那种触摸。

normal.en: decontamination removes the contamination: de- 'away' + contamination.
normal.cn: decontamination 去除污染：de-「离开」+ contamination。

abstract.en: Think of a drop of ink falling into a glass of clear water: the ink is contamination spreading.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴墨落入一杯清水：墨水就是扩散的 contamination。

abstract.en: Think of a clean white shirt being touched by a dirty hand: the stain is contamination.
abstract.cn: 想象干净的白衬衫被脏手触碰：污渍就是 contamination。

abstract.en: Think of radiation as invisible dirt touching everything: radioactive contamination.
abstract.cn: 想象辐射是看不见的灰尘触碰一切：放射性污染。

examples.en: The contamination of the food supply was traced to a faulty cooling system.
examples.cn: 食品供应的污染被追溯到故障的冷却系统。

examples.en: Cross-contamination between raw and cooked meat can cause food poisoning.
examples.cn: 生肉和熟肉之间的交叉污染会导致食物中毒。

examples.en: The study was flawed due to contamination of the control group.
examples.cn: 由于对照组受到干扰，该研究存在缺陷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康太闷内神」——康师傅在太闷的室内，手（tangere）一碰就脏 → contamination 污染

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all mean 'making something impure by contact': water, soil, data, language, or minds can all be contaminated.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都表示「因接触使某物不纯」：水、土壤、数据、语言或心灵都可能被污染。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dark drop spreading through clear liquid.
core.cn: 核心意象：一滴深色液体在清澈液体中扩散。

branches.cn: 物理污染：使物质或地方不纯。

branches.en: POLLUTING AGENT: the substance or radiation that causes the harm.
branches.cn: 污染源：造成危害的物质或辐射。

branches.en: MORAL/SOCIAL CORRUPTION: impurity spreading to people or institutions.
branches.cn: 道德/社会腐化：不纯蔓延到个人或机构。

intro.en: Contamination is the Latin-stem noun from contaminare. The suffix -ion marks the action or result; con- and tangere are fossilized.

latinIntro.en: Latin tangere 'to touch' produced a large family: tangent, tangible, contact, contagion, contaminate, integer (untouched). The root appears as tang-, tag-, tig-, or tact-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tangere「触摸」产生了大家族：tangent、tangible、contact、contagion、contaminate、integer（未触碰的）。词根以 tang-、tag-、tig- 或 tact- 形式出现。

items.meaning: the act or result of contaminating

items.meaningCN: 未触动的；完整的（in-「不」+ tactus）

items.example: The fabric has a tactile quality.

definition_zh: 连续性；连贯；衔接；（电影）连贯性
definition_en: the state of continuing without interruption; the way in which things connect together without sudden changes; in film, the consistency of details between shots
core_image: 一条线从一头拉到另一头，中间没有断开
scene: To ensure continuity in the story, the author kept the same narrator throughout the novel.
sceneCN: 这里 continuity 是「连贯性」（第 1 个义项：不间断的状态）；句意：为了保证故事的连贯性，作者在整部小说中保持同一个叙述者。图中可辨识物件：书本、钢笔、一条贯穿的线、人物剪影。

senses.title: The state of continuing without interruption
senses.definition: the state of continuing for a period of time without stopping or being interrupted
senses.definitionCN: 持续一段时间而不停顿或中断的状态
senses.example: The continuity of the music was broken by a sudden crash.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐的连续性被突然的碎裂声打断。
senses.why: Latin continere 'to hold together': continuity is the state of being held together as one unbroken thing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 continere「保持在一起」：continuity 是作为一个未断整体保持在一起的状态。

senses.title: Logical connection between parts
senses.definition: the way in which the parts of something connect together logically and consistently
senses.definitionCN: 某物各部分逻辑一致地连接在一起的方式
senses.example: There is a clear continuity between his early and late work.
senses.exampleCN: 他的早期和晚期作品之间有明显的连贯性。
senses.why: When ideas connect smoothly, the 'thread' holds them together in continuity.
senses.whyCN: 当观念顺畅连接时，「线」把它们保持在 continuity 中。

senses.title: Uninterrupted succession
senses.definition: an uninterrupted sequence or succession of things
senses.definitionCN: 事物不间断的序列或接续
senses.example: The team achieved a continuity of victories last season.
senses.exampleCN: 该队上赛季取得了连胜。
senses.why: Here continuity is a series of events with no gap between them.
senses.whyCN: 此处 continuity 是事件之间没有间隙的系列。

senses.title: Consistency of details in film
senses.definition: in film and television, the consistency of details such as props and costumes between shots
senses.definitionCN: 影视中，镜头之间道具、服装等细节的一致性
senses.example: The script supervisor is responsible for continuity.
senses.exampleCN: 场记负责镜头间的连贯性。
senses.why: In film, continuity keeps the fictional world from breaking when the camera cuts.
senses.whyCN: 在电影中，continuity 保证镜头切换时虚构世界不穿帮。

senses.title: Maintenance of an unbroken flow
senses.definition: the maintenance of an unbroken flow or operation, especially in business
senses.definitionCN: 尤指业务中保持不间断的流程或运转
senses.example: The company has a business continuity plan for emergencies.
senses.exampleCN: 公司有应对紧急情况的业务连续性计划。
senses.why: Business continuity means the operation keeps going even when disrupted.
senses.whyCN: 业务连续性意味着即使受到干扰，运营也能持续。

senses.title: A link connecting different periods
senses.definition: a feature or relationship that connects one period or stage to another
senses.definitionCN: 把一个时期或阶段与另一个连接起来的特征或关系
senses.example: The castle provides continuity between medieval and modern times.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城堡提供了中世纪与现代之间的衔接。
senses.why: Something that bridges two eras gives continuity of experience or memory.
senses.whyCN: 跨越两个时代的事物提供了经验或记忆的衔接。

senses.title: Mathematical property of functions
senses.definition: in mathematics, the property of a function whose graph has no breaks or jumps
senses.definitionCN: 数学中，函数图像没有断裂或跳跃的性质
senses.example: Students learn about continuity in calculus.
senses.exampleCN: 学生在微积分中学习连续性。
senses.why: In math, a continuous function can be drawn without lifting the pencil — the line holds together.
senses.whyCN: 在数学中，连续函数可以一笔画成——线保持不断。

senses.title: Unbroken existence through time
senses.definition: the state of existing or remaining the same over a long period
senses.definitionCN: 在长时间内存在或保持不变的状态
senses.example: The family business has remarkable continuity over three centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这家家族企业三个世纪以来持续存在，令人瞩目。
senses.why: When an institution survives unchanged, it shows continuity across time.
senses.whyCN: 当一个机构不变地存续下来，它就展示了跨越时间的 continuity。

intro.en: Continuity comes from Latin continuitas, from continuus 'uninterrupted', from continere 'to hold together'. The core is one thing holding together without a break.
intro.cn: continuity 来自拉丁 continuitas，源自 continuus「不间断的」，continuus 来自 continere「保持在一起」。核心是一物保持不断。

items.en: continere is con- 'together' + tenere 'to hold'. It means 'to hold together, contain'.
items.cn: continere 是 con-「一起」+ tenere「握住」。意为「保持在一起、容纳」。

items.en: continuus meant 'uninterrupted, continuous' — what holds together as one piece.
items.cn: continuus 意为「不间断的、连续的」——作为一块保持在一起的。

items.en: continuitas meant 'uninterrupted connection or succession'. It was borrowed into French and English.
items.cn: continuitas 意为「不间断的连接或接续」。它被借入法语和英语。

items.en: Continuity entered English in the 15th century from French continuité.
items.cn: continuity 在 15 世纪从法语 continuité 进入英语。

items.en: The mathematical sense developed in the 17th century; the film sense in the 20th.
items.cn: 数学义发展于 17 世纪；电影义发展于 20 世纪。

items.en: Today continuity appears in business, broadcasting, mathematics, and everyday talk about connection.
items.cn: 如今 continuity 出现在商业、广播、数学以及关于连接的日常谈论中。

note.en: The first group shares tenere; the second contains words near in meaning of connection or consistency.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tenere；第二组是连接或一致意义相近的词。

entries.definitionCN: 频繁发生或不停顿的；来自 continuus，后缀 -al

abstract.en: Think of drawing a line without lifting your pen: that line is continuity.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔画成一条线：这条线就是 continuity。

abstract.en: Think of a bridge spanning a river: it gives continuity between the two banks.
abstract.cn: 想象一座横跨河流的桥：它提供了两岸之间的连续性。

abstract.en: Think of a movie where a cup is full in one shot and empty in the next without explanation: that's broken continuity.

examples.en: There needs to be continuity between the old policy and the new one.

examples.en: The director fired the continuity clerk for missing a costume error.
examples.cn: 导演因场记漏看服装错误而解雇了她。

examples.en: The function has no continuity at this point because it jumps.
examples.cn: 该函数在这一点不连续，因为它发生了跳跃。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all mean 'holding together without a break': a story, a business, a film's details, or a mathematical line.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都表示「不断地保持在一起」：故事、业务、电影细节或数学线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an unbroken line drawn in one stroke.
core.cn: 核心意象：一笔画成的不间断的线。

branches.en: UNBROKEN SEQUENCE: events or states continuing without a gap.
branches.cn: 不间断序列：事件或状态无间隙地持续。

branches.en: CONNECTION ACROSS PARTS OR TIMES: a link that holds parts or eras together.
branches.cn: 跨部分或跨时代的连接：把部分或时代保持在一起的纽带。

branches.en: FILM CONTINUITY: consistent details between shots.
branches.cn: 电影连贯性：镜头间一致的细节。

branches.en: DURABLE OPERATION OR EXISTENCE: something that keeps going through time.
branches.cn: 持久的运转或存在：穿越时间持续的事物。

branches.en: MATHEMATICAL CONTINUITY: a function with no jumps or breaks.
branches.cn: 数学连续性：没有跳跃或断裂的函数。

intro.en: Continuity is the -ity noun from continuous, from Latin continuus. The suffix -ity is productive; the inner parts are fossilized.
intro.cn: continuity 是 continuous 的 -ity 名词，continuous 来自拉丁 continuus。后缀 -ity 有能产性；内部部分已凝固。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere 'to hold' produced a huge family: contain, retain, maintain, detain, sustain, obtain, continue. The root appears as ten-, tin-, tent-, or tain-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tenere「握住」产生了庞大家族：contain、retain、maintain、detain、sustain、obtain、continue。词根以 ten-、tin-、tent- 或 tain- 形式出现。

items.example: There is a discontinuity in the data.

definition_en: in a way that continues without stopping or interruption
core_image: 水流一刻不停地向前，中间没有断点
scene: The river has flowed continuously through this valley for thousands of years.
sceneCN: 这里 continuously 是「连续地」（第 1 个义项：不间断地）；句意：这条河已经连续不断地流过这个山谷数千年了。图中可辨识物件：河谷、流水、时间线、远山。

senses.title: Without stopping or interruption
senses.definition: in an unbroken manner, without pauses or gaps
senses.definitionCN: 以不间断的方式，没有停顿或间隙
senses.example: The machine ran continuously for twelve hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器连续运行了十二个小时。
senses.why: continuous + -ly: the adverb describes an action done in an unbroken manner.
senses.whyCN: continuous + -ly：副词描述以不间断方式进行的动作。

senses.title: At every point in time
senses.definition: at each and every moment, without exception
senses.definitionCN: 在每一个时刻，无一例外
senses.example: The patient was continuously observed overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 病人整夜被持续观察。
senses.why: Continuously here means 'at all times', not just for a long stretch.
senses.whyCN: 此处 continuously 意为「在所有时刻」，而不仅仅是很长一段时间。

senses.title: In an unbroken sequence
senses.definition: in a sequence with no missing elements or gaps
senses.definitionCN: 以没有缺失元素或间隙的序列
senses.example: The numbers are continuously numbered from 1 to 100.
senses.exampleCN: 这些编号从 1 到 100 连续排列。
senses.why: When items follow one after another with no gap, they are continuously arranged.
senses.whyCN: 当条目一个接一个没有间隙时，它们就是 continuously 排列的。

senses.title: Repeatedly over time
senses.definition: occurring repeatedly over a period of time without letup
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内反复发生而不停歇
senses.example: She continuously checked her phone for messages.
senses.exampleCN: 她不停地查看手机有没有消息。
senses.why: Here continuously stresses repetition without pause, not strict simultaneity.
senses.whyCN: 此处 continuously 强调不停歇的重复，而非严格的同时性。

senses.title: In mathematics, without jumps
senses.definition: in a way that changes smoothly without sudden jumps
senses.definitionCN: 以平滑变化、没有突然跳跃的方式
senses.example: The function varies continuously across the interval.
senses.exampleCN: 该函数在整个区间上连续变化。
senses.why: In math, a continuously varying function has no breaks in its graph.
senses.whyCN: 在数学中，continuously 变化的函数图像没有断裂。

senses.title: Without interruption in development
senses.definition: in a way that develops or progresses without interruption
senses.definitionCN: 以不间断发展或进展的方式
senses.example: The city has grown continuously for fifty years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市持续发展了五十年。
senses.why: When growth has no stops and starts, it proceeds continuously.
senses.whyCN: 当增长没有停停走走时，它就是 continuously 进行的。

senses.title: Steadily and persistently
senses.definition: in a steady and persistent manner
senses.definitionCN: 以稳定而持久的方式
senses.example: The stock price rose continuously throughout the day.
senses.exampleCN: 股价全天持续上涨。
senses.why: Continuously here emphasizes steady persistence rather than speed.
senses.whyCN: 此处 continuously 强调稳定持续，而非速度。

senses.title: All the while, throughout
senses.definition: during the whole time or period
senses.definitionCN: 在整个时间或期间内
senses.example: He continuously denied the allegations.
senses.exampleCN: 他始终否认这些指控。
senses.why: Continuously modifies the duration: the denial held throughout.
senses.whyCN: continuously 修饰持续时间：否认自始至终成立。

intro.en: Continuously is continuous + -ly. Continuous comes from Latin continuus 'uninterrupted', from continere 'to hold together'. The suffix -ly makes an adverb of manner.
intro.cn: continuously 是 continuous + -ly。continuous 来自拉丁 continuus「不间断的」，continuus 来自 continere「保持在一起」。后缀 -ly 构成方式副词。

items.en: continere 'to hold together' (con- + tenere) is the base.
items.cn: continere「保持在一起」（con- + tenere）是词根。

items.en: continuus meant 'uninterrupted' — what holds together as one piece.
items.cn: continuus 意为「不间断的」——作为一块保持在一起的。

items.en: Continuous entered English in the 17th century from French continu or Latin continuus.
items.cn: continuous 在 17 世纪从法语 continu 或拉丁 continuus 进入英语。

items.en: The Old English suffix -lice, modern -ly, turns adjectives into adverbs of manner.
items.cn: 古英语后缀 -lice，现代 -ly，把形容词变成方式副词。

items.en: continuously = continuous + -ly, meaning 'in a continuous manner'.
items.cn: continuously = continuous + -ly，意为「以连续的方式」。

items.en: Continuously is sometimes confused with continually; the former means 'without stopping', the latter 'frequently'.
items.cn: 用法提示：continuously 有时与 continually 混淆；前者意为「不停顿」，后者意为「频繁」。

note.en: The first group shares tenere; the second contains near-synonymous adverbs.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tenere；第二组是近义副词。

entries.definition: continuing without stopping; the adjective behind continuously
entries.definitionCN: 不停顿地持续的；continuously 背后的形容词

entries.definition: frequently or again and again; from continual, not continuous
entries.definitionCN: 频繁地或反复地；来自 continual，而非 continuous

entries.definition: all the time; from Latin constare 'to stand firm'
entries.definitionCN: 一直；来自拉丁 constare「站稳」

entries.definition: without interruption; the closest synonym to continuously
entries.definitionCN: 不间断地；continuously 最接近的同义词

entries.definition: without stopping; often with a negative tone of annoyance
entries.definitionCN: 不停地；常带负面的厌烦语气

entries.definition: in a way that never ends or changes; stresses permanence
entries.definitionCN: 永不结束或改变地；强调永久性

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: continuous (adj.) + -ly (adverb suffix): continuously = in a continuous way.
normal.cn: continuous（形容词）+ -ly（副词后缀）：continuously = 以连续的方式。

normal.en: continuously = no pauses; continually = frequent repeats. Don't mix them up.
normal.cn: continuously = 无停顿；continually = 频繁重复。别搞混。

normal.en: The root is tenere 'to hold': the action holds together without a break.
normal.cn: 词根是 tenere「握住」：动作保持不断。

normal.en: continuously describes how an action happens (manner), not whether it exists.
normal.cn: continuously 描述动作如何发生（方式），而非是否存在。

normal.en: discontinuously is the opposite: with breaks.
normal.cn: discontinuously 是反义词：有断裂。

abstract.en: Think of a river that never freezes and never dries: it flows continuously.
abstract.cn: 想象一条从不结冰也不干涸的河：它 continuously 流淌。

abstract.en: Think of -ly as 'in the manner of': continuously = in the manner of continuous.
abstract.cn: 把 -ly 想成「以……的方式」：continuously = 以 continuous 的方式。

abstract.en: Think of a heartbeat in a healthy person: it beats continuously for a lifetime.
abstract.cn: 想象健康人的心跳：它一生 continuously 跳动。

examples.en: The volcano has been erupting continuously for three weeks.
examples.cn: 这座火山已经连续喷发了三周。

examples.en: Data is continuously collected and analyzed around the clock.
examples.cn: 数据全天候被持续收集和分析。

examples.en: She continuously improved her skills through practice.
examples.cn: 她通过练习持续提高技能。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康提牛厄斯里」——康师傅提（tenere）着牛一路（-ly）走，没停 → continuously 连续地

root: 拉丁 continere「保持在一起」（con-「一起」+ tenere「握住」）→ continuus 形容词 → continuous + -ly 副词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe action done in an unbroken way: machines, observation, sequences, or growth.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都描述以不间断方式进行的动作：机器、观察、序列或增长。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flow that never pauses.
core.cn: 核心意象：永不停歇的流动。

branches.en: UNINTERRUPTED ACTION: something keeps going without pause.
branches.cn: 不间断动作：事物不停歇地持续。

branches.en: AT ALL TIMES: applies to every moment of a period.
branches.cn: 时时刻刻：适用于一段时期的每个时刻。

branches.en: GAPLESS SEQUENCE: elements follow with no missing ones.
branches.cn: 无间隙序列：元素连续无缺失。

branches.en: STEADY REPETITION: repeated without letup.
branches.cn: 稳定重复：不停歇地反复。

branches.en: SMOOTH MATHEMATICAL CHANGE: no jumps in value.
branches.cn: 平滑数学变化：数值无跳跃。

intro.en: Continuously is continuous + -ly. The suffix -ly is productive; the inner parts are fossilized.
intro.cn: continuously 是 continuous + -ly。后缀 -ly 有能产性；内部部分已凝固。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere 'to hold' produced continue, continuous, contain, retain, etc. The root appears as ten-, tin-, tent-, tain-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tenere「握住」产生了 continue、continuous、contain、retain 等。词根以 ten-、tin-、tent-、tain- 形式出现。

definition_zh: 收缩；缩小；收缩期；缩略形式；（经济）紧缩
definition_en: the process of becoming smaller or shorter; a muscle tightening; a shortened form of a word; a reduction in economic activity
core_image: 一只手把海绵捏紧，体积缩小
scene: The contraction of the metal in cold weather caused the bridge joints to widen.
sceneCN: 这里 contraction 是「收缩」（第 1 个义项：变小的过程）；句意：金属在寒冷天气中的收缩导致桥梁接缝变宽。图中可辨识物件：桥梁、金属梁、温度计、接缝。

senses.title: The process of becoming smaller
senses.definition: the process of becoming smaller in size, amount, or length
senses.definitionCN: 在大小、数量或长度上变小的过程
senses.example: The contraction of the material was measured in the lab.
senses.exampleCN: 材料的收缩在实验室中被测量。
senses.why: Latin trahere 'to draw' + con-: contrahere means 'to draw together', i.e., to shrink.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 trahere「拉」+ con-：contrahere 意为「拉到一起」，即收缩。

senses.title: A tightening of a muscle
senses.definition: the tightening and shortening of a muscle
senses.definitionCN: 肌肉的绷紧和缩短
senses.example: Contraction of the heart muscle pumps blood.
senses.exampleCN: 心肌的收缩泵送血液。
senses.why: When a muscle contracts, its fibers draw together and shorten.
senses.whyCN: 当肌肉收缩时，其纤维拉到一起并缩短。

senses.title: A shortened form of a word or phrase
senses.definition: a shorter form of a word or phrase made by omitting letters or sounds
senses.definitionCN: 通过省略字母或音而形成的词或短语的较短形式
senses.example: 'Don't' is a contraction of 'do not'.
senses.exampleCN: don't 是 do not 的缩略形式。
senses.why: In grammar, a contraction draws two words together into one shorter form.
senses.whyCN: 在语法中，contraction 把两个词拉到一起成一个较短形式。

senses.title: A reduction in economic activity
senses.definition: a period when economic activity decreases
senses.definitionCN: 经济活动减少的时期
senses.example: The country experienced a severe contraction last year.
senses.exampleCN: 该国去年经历了严重的经济紧缩。
senses.why: When the economy contracts, businesses and spending draw inward.
senses.whyCN: 当经济收缩时，企业和支出向内收拢。

senses.title: A period of pain in childbirth
senses.definition: a painful tightening of the uterus during childbirth
senses.definitionCN: 分娩时子宫的疼痛性收缩
senses.example: Her contractions were ten minutes apart.
senses.exampleCN: 她的阵痛间隔十分钟。
senses.why: In labor, each contraction is the uterus drawing together to push the baby out.
senses.whyCN: 分娩时，每次阵痛都是子宫收缩以推出婴儿。

senses.title: The act of making an agreement
senses.definition: the act of entering into a contract or agreement
senses.definitionCN: 订立合同或协议的行为
senses.example: The contraction of the deal took months of negotiation.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔交易的订立花了数月谈判。
senses.why: A contract is drawn up when parties come together; contraction names that act.
senses.whyCN: 当各方聚在一起时起草合同；contraction 命名该行为。

senses.title: A narrowing or tightening
senses.definition: the act of becoming narrower or tighter
senses.definitionCN: 变窄或变紧的行为
senses.example: The contraction of the blood vessels raised blood pressure.
senses.exampleCN: 血管的收缩使血压升高。
senses.why: Vessels contract by drawing their walls together, narrowing the channel.
senses.whyCN: 血管通过把管壁拉到一起而收缩，使通道变窄。

senses.title: A shortened version in writing
senses.definition: a written abbreviation or compressed form
senses.definitionCN: 书面的缩写或压缩形式
senses.example: The editor requested a contraction of the manuscript.
senses.exampleCN: 编辑要求对手稿进行压缩。
senses.why: Figuratively, a text can be contracted by drawing its parts closer together.
senses.whyCN: 比喻地，文本可以通过把各部分拉近而被压缩。

intro.en: Contraction comes from Latin contractio, from contrahere 'to draw together'. The root trahere 'to draw, pull' appears in many English words.
intro.cn: contraction 来自拉丁 contractio，源自 contrahere「拉到一起」。词根 trahere「拉」出现在许多英语词中。

items.en: trahere meant 'to draw, pull, drag'. It is the base of a large family.
items.cn: trahere 意为「拉、拖」。它是一个大家族的词根。

items.en: con- adds 'together'. contrahere is 'to draw together', hence 'to shrink, to make an agreement'.
items.cn: con- 加上「一起」。contrahere 是「拉到一起」，因此「收缩、订立协议」。

items.en: contractus, past participle of contrahere, gave the stem contract-.
items.cn: contractus，contrahere 的过去分词，提供了词干 contract-。

items.en: contractio meant 'a drawing together, a shrinking, an agreement'.
items.cn: contractio 意为「拉到一起、收缩、协议」。

items.en: Contraction entered English in the 15th century with both physical and legal senses.
items.cn: contraction 在 15 世纪进入英语，兼具物理和法律义。

items.en: The grammatical sense 'shortened form' developed in the 18th century.
items.cn: 语法义「缩略形式」发展于 18 世纪。

note.en: The first group shares trahere; the second contains near-synonyms for shrinking.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trahere；第二组是收缩的近义词。

entries.definition: to shrink; a legal agreement; the base behind contraction
entries.definitionCN: 收缩；合同；contraction 背后的词根

entries.definition: to pull out; ex- 'out' + trahere
entries.definitionCN: 拔出；ex-「出」+ trahere

entries.definition: to pull the attention away; dis- + trahere
entries.definitionCN: 分散注意力；dis- + trahere

entries.definition: the amount by which something shrinks; close to the physical sense
entries.definitionCN: 某物缩小的量；接近物理义

entries.definition: the act of making something smaller or less; broader than contraction
entries.definitionCN: 使某物变小或变少的行为；比 contraction 更广

entries.definition: the act of pressing something into a smaller space; close to contraction
entries.definitionCN: 把某物压入更小空间的行为；接近 contraction

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: con- 'together' + trahere 'to draw': contraction is drawing things together so they shrink.
normal.cn: con-「一起」+ trahere「拉」：contraction 是把东西拉到一起使其缩小。

normal.en: contract is the verb/noun; contraction is the noun of the action or result.
normal.cn: contract 是动词/名词；contraction 是动作或结果的名词。

normal.en: extract (ex-) pulls out; distract (dis-) pulls away; contraction (con-) pulls together.
normal.cn: extract（ex-）拉出；distract（dis-）拉开；contraction（con-）拉到一起。

normal.en: Grammatical contractions like 'don't' pull two words together.
normal.cn: 语法缩略如 don't 把两个词拉到一起。

normal.en: Economic contraction is the opposite of expansion: the economy shrinks.
normal.cn: 经济紧缩是扩张的反面：经济缩小。

abstract.en: Think of a fist closing: fingers draw together, the hand shrinks — that's contraction.
abstract.cn: 想象拳头握紧：手指收拢，手变小——这就是 contraction。

abstract.en: Think of a sponge squeezed: water is pushed out, size shrinks — contraction.
abstract.cn: 想象海绵被挤压：水被挤出，体积缩小——contraction。

abstract.en: Think of 'do not' being pulled into 'don't': two words drawn into one — a contraction.
abstract.cn: 想象 do not 被拉成 don't：两个词收成一个——缩略。

examples.en: Cold causes the contraction of metal, which can loosen bolts.
examples.cn: 寒冷导致金属收缩，可能使螺栓松动。

examples.en: Strong contractions of the diaphragm cause hiccups.
examples.cn: 横膈膜的强烈收缩导致打嗝。

examples.en: The economy went through a sharp contraction after the crisis.
examples.cn: 危机后经济经历了急剧紧缩。

root: 拉丁 contrahere「拉到一起、收缩、订立」（con-「一起」+ trahere「拉」）；contract- 词干 + -ion 名词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all mean 'drawing together': muscles, metal, words, the economy, or a deal.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都表示「拉到一起」：肌肉、金属、词语、经济或交易。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand closing into a fist, pulling everything inward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手攥成拳，把一切向内收拢。

branches.en: PHYSICAL SHRINKING: things become smaller or narrower.
branches.cn: 物理收缩：事物变小或变窄。

branches.en: MUSCULAR TIGHTENING: muscles or the uterus draw together.
branches.cn: 肌肉收紧：肌肉或子宫收缩。

branches.en: VERBAL COMPRESSION: words or text are shortened.
branches.cn: 语言压缩：词或文本被缩短。

branches.en: ECONOMIC DECLINE: activity pulls inward and decreases.
branches.cn: 经济衰退：活动向内收缩并减少。

branches.en: LEGAL AGREEMENT: parties come together to make a contract.
branches.cn: 法律协议：各方聚在一起订立合同。

intro.en: Contraction is the Latin-stem noun from contrahere. The suffix -ion marks the action; con- and trahere are fossilized.

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere 'to draw' produced a huge family: contract, extract, distract, attract, subtract, tractor, trait, trace. The root appears as trah-, tract-, or tray-.
